front: Ritual that shares a memory-meal with up to 10 friends, giving them a week of bonus to pass as being from your old community. Friends of 4th level or lower can benefit.
back:
Crit Success: +4 circumstance bonus to Deception and Diplomacy to convince people from the meal's origin community that they're from there or were at events you described, for 1 week; they can recreate the dish as well as you.
Success: +2 bonus instead; they can't make the meal.
Failure: no bonus.
Crit Failure: -2 circumstance penalty to those checks vs. people from your old community for 1 week.
Heightened (4th): up to 8th level, 40 gp.
(6th): up to 12th level, 150 gp.
(8th): up to 16th level, 480 gp.
(10th): any level, 2000 gp.
